recognize_zh: 低倍下可見纖維化的軟組織中有厚壁肌性血管、旁邊脂肪組織，以及混有淋巴球群聚、漿細胞與淡染組織球的密集浸潤；纖維化明顯的腫塊樣病灶為結外 Rosai-Dorfman 病常見樣貌。
features: Low-power soft tissue with a thick-walled muscular vessel and adjacent adipose tissue
Dense fibrosis surrounding the vessel and at the lesion periphery
Mixed infiltrate of lymphoid aggregates, plasma cells, and pale histiocytes
Emperipolesis not assessable at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power sections of extranodal soft tissue show a fibrotic lesion containing a thick-walled muscular vessel, bordered by mature adipose tissue. The lesion is composed of a dense mixed infiltrate of lymphoid aggregates, plasma cells, and paler histiocyte-rich zones within collagenous stroma. There is no obvious necrosis; emperipolesis cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are compatible with extranodal Rosai-Dorfman disease with prominent fibrosis, as confirmed on high-power and S100 stains.

ddx.vs: IgG4-RD shows storiform fibrosis and obliterative phlebitis with IgG4/IgG >40%, and lacks S100+ histiocytes with emperipolesis.
IMT has fascicles of ALK-positive myofibroblasts in an inflammatory background rather than large pale histiocytes.
cHL contains CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells and lacunar cells within sclerotic bands.
